text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Troops launch a huge search operation in Chebli, south of Algiers, after the massacre of 30 villagers there. Several explosions were heard from the area.
- Algeria celebrates knowledge day, remembering scholar Abdelhamid Ibrahim's efforts to spread literacy and knowledge under French colonial rule.

- Party sources expected former Prime Minister Redha Malek to compete against Islamist leader Mahfoud Nahnah in the legislative election in Algiers. The Algerian capital is the big prize in the elections with 20 seats.
- The government plans to reform customs law to spur export-oriented business.
- Algerian pilgrims safe from a big fire in Saudi Arabia's Mecca.
